msg: warning: Variable buf is a dead store!
reasoning: FALSE POSITIVE: eef2317b9f5.c (BusyBox). Dead store on 'buf' at line 26 ('buf = malloc(bufsize)') when !def(CONFIG_FEATURE_CLEAN_UP). When FEATURE_CLEAN_UP is false, the cleanup block (lines 29-33) is not compiled, so buf is assigned from malloc but never subsequently read or freed — simplification artifact. In the real BusyBox code, buf would be used to buffer data. The dead store is a consequence of the simplification omitting buf's subsequent uses.
